relations.subject: Mortimer Wheeler
relations.evidence: In 1914 married Tessa Verney (b. 1893), one son, the lawyer Michael Mortimer Wheeler. She died in 1936. [...] The first and third wife were also archaeologists.

relations.subject: Mortimer Wheeler
relations.evidence: Soon after war in 1945 married Margaret “Kim” Collingridge (1916–1990, separated 1956, but not divorced). The first and third wife were also archaeologists.
